key_impacts: Nuclear fuel inside the reactors melted following the accident.
Cooling operations generated extremely contaminated water that leaked into the reactor building basements.
Large numbers of 1,000-ton tanks were installed onsite to store contaminated water, filling the Fukushima Daiichi site.
About 400 tons of groundwater flowed into the site each day, increasing contaminated water volumes.
missing_information: Impact numbers such as evacuated population or casualties not provided.
Directly impacted settlements beyond the plant site are not specified.
